title: Rosemary 26 Falmouth Ln Rosemary Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontGulf Views-Rosemary Beach Carriage House- Private Beach- 2 Minute Walk-2 FREE bikes-Heated PoolThe Space Frog Cottage – Charming Carriage House Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf Views – Enjoy stunning coastal scenery from your carriage house 2-Minute Walk to Private Beach – Quick & easy access to Rosemary Beach’s sugar-white sands Tons of Rosemary Beach Amenities – Pools, fitness trails, green spaces & more! Sky Pool Heated – Enjoy year-round relaxation in a luxurious setting 2 Free Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic paths & local hotspots One Covered Parking Space – Convenient & secure carport parking Professionally Decorated & Designed for Comfort – Versatile living space with custom features Custom Bunk Room for Kids – Each bunk has its own reading light & outlet Fully Equipped Kitchen – Featuring granite countertops & stainless steel appliances High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Frog CottageLocated in Rosemary Beach just a two minute walk to the private beach! This 2-bedroom, professionally decorated carriage house has everything you need for an unforgettable vacation.The main level of this carriage house includes the gorgeous kitchen, living room, bathroom and "bedroom". The kitchen boasts granite counter tops, stainless steel appliances and gorgeous wooden cabinets. The living room and bedroom areas are separated by custom curtains. The living area has plenty of seating to lounge and watch tv or pull the chairs up to the table to eat a meal. This carriage house is designed to be versatile. The bedroom has a queen-sized bed and shares a bathroom with the rest of the carriage house. Feel free to flip the smart TV around to watch in bed! The bathroom has a walk-in shower with an adjustable length shower head and a single vanity.Make your way up the spiral stair case and you will find the bunk room. These custom-built bunk beds are the perfect spot for the kids to hang on vacation! Each bed has its own reading light and outlet. This space also has cabinets to store clothes and a flat screen mounted smart TV.Rosemary Beach is a New Urbanism community located along the Florida panhandle's scenic Route 30A between Panama City and Destin. The 107-acre, Gulf-front town was designed in 1995 to offer residents and visitors alike a sense of community, neighborhood, and convenience. Common "green" areas are located throughout Rosemary Beach and provide places for reading, games, picnics and barefoot strolls, as well as outdoor events. The fitness trail and walking tour is a 2.3-mile trail that utilizes sand paths and boardwalks to wind through the town’s native landscape, parks, and public spaces.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** Rosemary Beach HOA does not allow golf carts in this community***** There is currently construction across from the home***SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4):Queen sized bed on main level - this room is separated by a curtain2 twin beds on the top level - this is a loft with no doorAREA ATTRACTIONS:Keep things casual with a quick stop at Summer Kitchen Café for fresh, healthy fare; or experience modern, creative cuisine at The Pearl’s Havana Beach Bar & Grill, an award-winning restaurant with breathtaking views. Pick up a sweet treat at the Sugar Shak or splurge on a glass of drinkable chocolate at La Crema.Spend a day shopping through Rosemary Beach, which offers everything from handpicked books at The Hidden Lantern to luxurious bath and body products at Pish Posh Patchouli’s. Find your perfect beach outfit at one of many clothing boutiques or pick up an adorable accessory at one of Rosemary Beach’s children’s stores. This beach neighborhood even has a shop dedicated to selling shoes — making Rosemary Beach a perfect destination from head to toe.Show less
